100461.title: Front wheel component relationships
guidance: Inspect 1 EA HL Hub (Product Number HU-8998) and 1 EA HL Mountain Rim (Product Number RM-M823) for visible damage. Place them in an assumed wheel-building stand. See the schematic component relationships in illustration 100461.

Fit 36 EA Spokes (Product Number SK-9283) between the hub and rim, using 36 EA HL Nipple (Product Number NI-9522) at the rim. The lacing pattern is not specified in the supplied data; confirm it before assembly.

Inspect and fit 1 EA Mountain Tire Tube (Product Number TT-M928) inside 1 EA HL Mountain Tire (Product Number TI-M823), then fit both to the rim, taking care not to pinch the tube. Inflate according to applicable manufacturer guidance and check seating.
Fit 2 EA Reflector (Product Number RF-9198) using their applicable attachment guidance; their precise mounting arrangement is not supplied.
